# Lexfall

> Lexfall is a daily lesson path for advanced English (C1-C2). Short lessons teach the words that matter for your work, your exam or everyday life, then smart reviews make them stick. On iPhone and Android. For when good English isn't enough.

Lexfall teaches advanced English (C1-C2) through short daily lessons on a path built for you. Pick your level and your field (healthcare, law, business or general English) or the exam you are preparing for (IELTS, OET, TOEFL, TOLES, PLAB, Cambridge C1 and C2 and more). Every lesson gives you a few new words, a quick check, and smart reviews later, so the words stick and you climb lesson by lesson from your level up to Expert. Between lessons, new words reach you on a swipe feed and on your Home and Lock Screen widgets. 20,000+ advanced words, with meaning, example and pronunciation on every one.

Key facts:

- A daily lesson path (the Journey): a few new words, a quick check, smart reviews later. Each lesson you finish moves you up, from your level towards Expert. The first lesson is guided (two words and a few checks).
- Built for your level (Intermediate, Advanced, Expert, picked in one tap or checked with a few words; no placement test) and your field or exam.
- Five fields: General, Healthcare, Law, Business and New Words (recently coined language).
- Word lists for 15 exams: IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, OET, PLAB, TOLES, PTE Academic, Duolingo English Test, Cambridge C1 Advanced, Cambridge C2 Proficiency, GRE Verbal, Linguaskill Business, Michigan ECPE, LanguageCert C1/C2 and Trinity ISE. Adding an exam makes your lessons and checks pull from its list.
- 20,000+ advanced English words, each with a plain definition, a real example sentence, its CEFR level and audio pronunciation (British, American and other accents).
- Between lessons: a swipe feed to keep the good ones, and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that show a new word every time you look (Save and Next buttons on iOS 17 and later).
- Your library: saved words, your own notebook, the areas you follow. Add to Lexfall from the Share sheet in Safari or any app. Notebook export as text or CSV.
- Pricing model: free to download, with a free trial (the monthly plan has a 14-day free trial). After the trial, a monthly or annual subscription unlocks every field, exam list and premium feature. Cancel any time in App Store or Google Play settings.
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 15.1 or later) and Android (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gpeysack.lexfall).
- Lexfall teaches vocabulary. It is not a full exam course, does not mark your work, and is not affiliated with any exam body.

Website: https://lexfall.app/  
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6786614029  
Short version: https://lexfall.app/llms.txt

## How Lexfall works

1. Daily lessons: each short lesson gives you a few new words, each with its meaning, a real example and its sound, then a quick check with hints. Smart reviews bring every word back later, just before you would forget it.
2. Your path: the Journey is a path of lessons. Each one you finish moves you further up, from your level towards Expert. Add a path for a field or an exam and they climb side by side.
3. Your level, your field: pick Intermediate, Advanced or Expert in one tap, then General, Healthcare, Law, Business or New Words. Your first lesson is guided.
4. Exam prep: word lists for 15 exams. Add the exam you are preparing for and your lessons and checks pull from its list.
5. Between lessons: a swipe feed (meaning, example and pronunciation on every card; keep the good ones) and Home and Lock Screen widgets with a new word every time you look.
6. Your library: saved words, your own notebook and the areas you follow, all in one place.

Definitions are for language learning, not medical or legal advice.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is Lexfall?

Lexfall is a daily lesson path for advanced English (C1-C2), on iPhone and Android. Short lessons teach the words that matter for your work, your exam or everyday life, then smart reviews make them stick. Pick your level and your field (healthcare, law, business or general English) or one of 15 exams, and you climb lesson by lesson from your level up to Expert. Between lessons, a swipe feed and Home and Lock Screen widgets keep new words in front of you. It is free to download on the App Store and Google Play.

### How does a lesson work?

Each short lesson on your Journey gives you a few new words, each with its meaning, a real example and its sound, then a quick check with hints. Smart reviews bring every word back later, just before you would forget it. Each lesson you finish moves you further up the path, from your level towards Expert. Your first lesson is guided: two words and a few checks, so you see how it works.

### What is a good app for advanced English vocabulary?

If beginner apps feel too easy, you need one that starts where they stop. Lexfall is a daily lesson path for advanced English (C1-C2): each short lesson teaches a few words with their meaning, a real example sentence and their pronunciation, checks them, and brings them back with smart reviews so they stay. The path is built for your level and your field (general English, healthcare, law, business or new words) or your exam. Whatever app you use, reading widely in English and noting the words you meet is still the best partner to it.

### Is there an app for IELTS vocabulary?

Yes. Lexfall has word lists for 15 exams, including IELTS, TOEFL, OET, PTE Academic, TOEIC, Cambridge C1 Advanced and C2 Proficiency, TOLES and PLAB. Add an exam and your daily lessons and checks pull words from its list. You can browse free sample lists on our word lists page, starting with IELTS Academic vocabulary. Lexfall teaches vocabulary only; it is not a full IELTS course.

### How do I learn C1 and C2 words?

A few at a time, in context, and reviewed over weeks. Learn each word with its meaning, a real example sentence and its sound. Check yourself on it a little later, then review it again just before you would forget it (spaced review). Use it in your own writing or speech within a day or two. Lexfall builds these steps into short daily lessons on a path, so you do not have to plan them.

### What level do I need?

Lexfall is for upper-intermediate to expert learners who want C1 and C2 English, and for native speakers who want more range. You pick your level in one tap: Intermediate, Advanced or Expert. Not sure? Check with a few words instead, so you start on words you don't already know. Your path starts at your level, your first lesson is guided, and you can change your level any time.

### Is Lexfall free?

Lexfall is free to download and starts with a free trial; the monthly plan includes a 14-day free trial. After the trial, a subscription (monthly or annual) unlocks every field, exam list and premium feature. It renews automatically, and you can cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

### Which devices does it run on?

Lexfall runs on iPhone (iOS 15.1 or later) and on Android phones through Google Play.

### Which fields and exams does it cover?

Five fields: General, Healthcare, Law, Business and New Words (the language still being coined). Fifteen exams: IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC, OET, PLAB, TOLES, PTE Academic, Duolingo English Test, Cambridge C1 Advanced, Cambridge C2 Proficiency, GRE Verbal, Linguaskill Business, Michigan ECPE, LanguageCert C1/C2 and Trinity ISE. 20,000+ words in total.

### Can I add words I find elsewhere?

Yes. Select a word in Safari or another app, tap Share, then Add to Lexfall, and it goes straight into your notebook. If Lexfall does not have it yet, it is saved as your own word with your meaning. You can export your notebook as text or CSV.

### How does the widget work?

Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show a fresh word every few hours, so new words stay in front of you between lessons. On iOS 17 and later you can save the word or skip to the next one right from the widget.

### Is it a full exam course?

No, it is a vocabulary tool, not an exam course: it does not coach the test or mark your work. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the organisations behind any of the exams it lists, such as IELTS, TOEFL, OET, Cambridge English, TOLES or GRE.

### Something is not working. Who do I contact?

Write to us from the Support page and we will reply by email.

## Word lists on lexfall.app

### [IELTS Academic Vocabulary: Words for a Higher Band](https://lexfall.app/ielts-academic-vocabulary)

Precise academic vocabulary for IELTS Writing Task 2 and Speaking: hedging, argument verbs and the words that lift a band score, each with a real example. IELTS rewards precise, natural word choice (the Lexical Resource score in Writing and Speaking). This page lists the academic verbs, hedging language, nouns and adjectives that make a Writing Task 2 essay or a Speaking answer more exact, each with a definition and a real example. Learn a few a day and use them in your own practice answers.

### [TOEFL Vocabulary List: Academic Words for the iBT](https://lexfall.app/toefl-vocabulary-list)

A TOEFL iBT vocabulary list of academic words from lectures and reading passages, each with a clear definition and a real example sentence. 40 TOEFL vocabulary words at C1 and C2 level, grouped by part of speech. Each has a plain definition, its level and a real example sentence. Learn a few a day and review them over several weeks; reading the list once is not enough.

### [TOEIC Vocabulary List: Workplace English Words](https://lexfall.app/toeic-vocabulary-list)

A TOEIC vocabulary list of the workplace words that appear in Listening and Reading: offices, contracts, travel, purchasing and meetings, with examples. 40 TOEIC vocabulary words at C1 and C2 level, grouped by part of speech. Each has a plain definition, its level and a real example sentence. Learn a few a day and review them over several weeks; reading the list once is not enough.

### [Medical English Vocabulary for the OET](https://lexfall.app/medical-english-vocabulary-oet)

Clinical English for the OET: history-taking, examination, handover and patient-facing words, each with a genuine example and the vocabulary underneath them. The OET tests English for healthcare professionals in clinical settings. This page lists the medical vocabulary of a consultation: taking a history, examination and signs, the ward and handover, and talking with patients, each with a definition and a real example. It is vocabulary practice, not clinical guidance.

### [OET Letter Writing Vocabulary: Referral Phrases](https://lexfall.app/oet-letter-writing-vocabulary)

Vocabulary for the OET Writing sub-test: the formal phrases of referral, discharge and transfer letters, each with a definition and example. 40 OET Writing vocabulary words at C1 and C2 level, grouped by part of speech. Each has a plain definition, its level and a real example sentence. Learn a few a day and review them over several weeks; reading the list once is not enough.

### [PLAB Vocabulary: Clinical English for UK Practice](https://lexfall.app/plab-vocabulary)

Clinical vocabulary for PLAB 1 and PLAB 2: the conditions, signs, procedures and patient-facing phrases of UK medical practice, each with an example. 40 PLAB vocabulary words at C1 and C2 level, grouped by topic. Each has a plain definition, its level and a real example sentence. Learn a few a day and review them over several weeks; reading the list once is not enough.

### [TOLES Vocabulary: Legal English Words and Phrases](https://lexfall.app/toles-legal-english-vocabulary)

Legal English vocabulary for TOLES: contract terms, litigation language and the formal phrases of legal drafting, each with a real example. 40 TOLES vocabulary words at B2 to C2 level, grouped by part of speech. Each has a plain definition, its level and a real example sentence. Learn a few a day and review them over several weeks; reading the list once is not enough.

### [GRE Vocabulary: High-Value Words to Know](https://lexfall.app/gre-vocabulary-words)

High-value GRE vocabulary for Text Completion and Sentence Equivalence, grouped by meaning, with a genuine example sentence for every word. GRE Verbal questions such as Text Completion and Sentence Equivalence turn on knowing a word precisely. This page lists high-value GRE words grouped by sense (how people speak, praise and censure, clear versus obscure, temperament) plus key nouns, each with a definition and a real example. Learn them in context and review them over weeks rather than memorising a definition once.

### [USMLE English for IMGs: The Vocabulary Behind the Interview](https://lexfall.app/usmle-english-for-imgs)

International medical graduates: the interview, patient and ward English that question banks rarely cover, with phrases to practice and the vocabulary underneath them. For international medical graduates, the gap is often how you say what you know. This page gives ten phrases for hedging and reassurance, talking with patients, interviews and handoffs, then explains how to build the medical vocabulary behind them.

### [Business English Vocabulary to Sound Senior](https://lexfall.app/business-english-vocabulary)

Finance, negotiation, leadership and meeting-room English for non-native professionals, each with a genuine example sentence and the register underneath it. Sounding senior in English comes from precise words, not more words. This page lists business vocabulary for finance, negotiation, leading a team, and meetings and email, each with a definition and a real example.

### [Legal English for Lawyers: The Vocabulary a Law Degree Rarely Teaches](https://lexfall.app/legal-english-for-lawyers)

Contract, client and negotiation English for lawyers who work in a second language: the phrases to practice and the vocabulary underneath them. Legal English is a register as much as a vocabulary. This page gives ten phrases for contract drafting, client letters, negotiation and formal writing, then explains how to build the precise legal vocabulary behind them.
